label: Sanctions Imposed on Russia
deltaNote: The 'Lindsey O. Graham Sanctioning Russia and Iran Act of 2026' passed the Senate 86-11, authorizing tariffs up to 100% on countries (incl. China, India) still buying large volumes of Russian oil/gas. Now awaits a House vote after the Aug 31 recess. EU's 21st package (Jul 2026) also added export-control listings on Chinese/Hong Kong entities.
